pages.text: The Mystic Branch is the witch's focus for stolen creature force. In older tales it is described as a wand for tracing spells through the air, but in the live port its practical role is simpler and no less useful: it releases the creature power you have already stored within yourself.

To obtain one, work the night-only infusion rite that turns an $(item)Ent Twig$() and $(item)Mystic Unguent$() into a $(item)Mystic Branch$() on the paired ritual circles. The live port accepts the work for $(bold)3000 altar power$(/) and drops a fresh branch into the circle when the rite succeeds.

pages.title: Current Use
pages.text: Use the branch while holding stored creature-power charges from altar sacrifice work. In the current port it spends one charge to release your bound power directly: swift speed, impossible leaps, healing force, enderman-like transposition, or bat-light levitation, depending on what power you carry.$(br2)The older air-glyph spellcasting and demonic branch-spell lore are not fully restored yet, so treat the branch as a creature-power focus first and a future spell instrument second.
